shortDescription: Manage Layer-2 interface on Extreme Networks SLX-OS devices.

options.name: access_vlan
options.description: Configure given VLAN in access port. If C(mode=access), used as the access VLAN ID.

options.name: mode
options.description: Mode in which interface needs to be configured.

options.name: name
options.description: Full name of the interface excluding any logical unit number, i.e. Ethernet 0/1.

options.name: native_vlan
options.description: Native VLAN to be configured in trunk port. If C(mode=trunk), used as the trunk native VLAN ID.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the Layer-2 Interface configuration.

options.name: trunk_allowed_vlans
options.description: List of allowed VLANs in a given trunk port. If C(mode=trunk), these are the only VLANs that will be configured on the trunk, i.e. "2-10,15".

options.name: trunk_vlans
options.description: List of VLANs to be configured in trunk port. If C(mode=trunk), used as the VLAN range to ADD or REMOVE from the trunk.
